svg.aria-label: What if a reading looks valid but is not? It fails: Reading a photographed lab report can misread a value, and a misread can still look like a good number. It catches: Only value shapes it knows are accepted; a row that does not match is left out, not guessed. Limit: <8.5 read in place of <0.5 looks valid, so it is kept.
